title: 4-Storey Curvilinear Mixed-Use Architectural Development
shortDescription: Distinctive 4-storey contemporary architectural mixed-use development featuring smooth curved cantilevered balconies, custom window apertures, and perimeter safety scaffolding.
overview: An architectural landmark project showcasing contemporary spatial design and curvilinear execution. The 4-level building features a sweeping curved frontal elevation, continuous cantilevered balconies on each upper floor, multi-coat exterior screeding, architectural parapet styling, and mixed commercial/residential zoning.
objectives: Deliver a visually commanding contemporary building that maximizes street frontage presence, promotes natural cross-ventilation through curved balconies, and incorporates durable weatherproofing.
scopeOfWork: Architectural design, radial formwork engineering, cantilevered balcony structural detailing, exterior screeding and rendering, window frame installations, and modular scaffolding.
technicalApproach: Custom radial formwork templates for curved floor slabs and balustrade curbs, weather-resistant sand-cement exterior rendering, and perimeter tubular steel scaffolding with safety netting.
projectOutcome: Distinctive curved frontal facade achieved with smooth radial continuity for contemporary commercial and residential occupancy.
metaDescription: Architectural design and construction of a 4-storey curvilinear building with curved balconies by SPES Swiftpace.
